ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels represent <5% of the visible surface; low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels represent >95%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark pigmentation across both lobes; localized mid-intensity grey mottling in the medial-proximal regions near the fluke base; absence of high-contrast white contiguous blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a vertex angle estimated at 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations is maximal at the lateral distal margins, creating a tattered appearance.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trailing edge trajectory with a distinct sharp upward (cranial) inflection at the terminal lateral lobe points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters detected in the medial region of the right lobe; irregular bumpy clusters on the lateral-most margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct dark linear stroke on the middle-left lobe, oriented diagonally (approx. 20 degrees relative to horizontal).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and scarring on both lateral tips; prominent healed linear scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme 'shredded' or irregular jaggedness of the outer lateral margins is highly distinctive.
